title: A01. Remove the composition
statement:
Classify the integer-valued functions on the integers for which
$$f(2x)+2f(y)=f(f(x+y))\qquad(x,y\in\mathbb Z).$$

title: A02. The exact cost of monotonicity
statement: Given real $a_1,\ldots,a_n$, set $M_i=\max_{j\le i}a_j$, $m_i=\min_{j\ge i}a_j$, and $d=\max_i(M_i-m_i)$. Prove that the least possible value of $\max_i|x_i-a_i|$, over nondecreasing real sequences $(x_i)$, is $d/2$.

title: A03. A floor map eventually repeats
statement: Starting from an arbitrary real $a_0$, iterate $a_{r+1}=\lfloor a_r\rfloor\{a_r\}$, where $\{x\}=x-\lfloor x\rfloor$. Prove that eventually $a_{r+2}=a_r$.

title: A04. Cancel the exceptional coefficient
statement: Let $a_0=-1$ and, for $n\ge1$, let $\sum_{k=0}^n a_k/(n-k+1)=0$. Show that every $a_n$ with $n\ge1$ is positive.

title: A05. Translate a quartic into a norm
statement:
Real $a,b,c,d$ have sum $6$ and sum of squares $12$. Prove
$$36\le4\sum a^3-\sum a^4\le48,$$
where both sums run over the four variables.

title: A06. Reverse the coefficients, keep the answer
statement: For real $a_1,\ldots,a_{n-1}$, define $u_0=u_1=1$ and $u_{k+1}=u_k+a_ku_{k-1}$. Define $v_0=v_1=1$ by the same recurrence with $a_1,\ldots,a_{n-1}$ reversed. Prove $u_n=v_n$.

title: A07. A unique crossing
statement:
For strictly increasing positive integers $z_0,z_1,\ldots$, prove that exactly one $n\ge1$ satisfies
$$z_n<\frac{z_0+\cdots+z_n}{n}\le z_{n+1}.$$

title: A08. An endpoint certificate for variance
statement: Real numbers $u_1,\ldots,u_{2019}$ have sum zero and squared sum one. If $a$ and $b$ are their minimum and maximum, prove $ab\le-1/2019$.

title: A09. Pair the cyclic ratios
statement: Positive $a,b,c,d$ satisfy $(a+c)(b+d)=ac+bd$. Determine the minimum of $a/b+b/c+c/d+d/a$.

title: A10. Integer averages cannot rise too slowly
statement: Find real $\alpha$ for which $n$ divides $\sum_{k=1}^n\lfloor k\alpha\rfloor$ for every positive integer $n$.

title: A11. Pay for one unit at a time
statement: Minimize $\sum_{i=0}^n2^i x_i^2$ over nonnegative integers with $\sum_{i=0}^n x_i=n$.

title: A13. A polynomial has a definite sign
statement: Positive integers $a_i$ satisfy $\sum 1/a_i=k\in\mathbb Z_{>0}$ and $\prod a_i=M>1$. Show that $M(x+1)^k-\prod(x+a_i)$ has no positive real root.

title: A14. A sharp quadratic majorant
statement: For $N=2^n$ with $n\ge1$, find the least $c$ such that $((1+x^{2N})/2)^{1/N}\le x+c(x-1)^2$ for every real $x$.

title: A15. The radical inequality and its sharp parameter
A16. Measure a union of rational-inequality intervals
statement: Show that the real solution set of $\sum_{k=1}^{70} k/(x-k)\ge5/4$ is a disjoint union of intervals whose total length is $1988$; the poles are excluded from the domain.
